craft_notes: Sthāyin: hearing — Nāda-Bhairava named. Rows: hearing then naming. Rejected: softening Bhairava — killed: proper dread kept. Read aloud: hush then thunder.

lines: Hearing what dwells between the twin wheels — when tremor ends, they settle there.
So this, eightfold and uttermost: Roar-Bhairava.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tac cakradvayamadhyagam ākarṇya kṣobhavigamasamaye yat nirvānti tatra caivaṃ yo 'ṣṭavidho nādabhairavaḥ paramaḥ
